s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent lesion of the nasal vestibule with local invasion
salient_findings: Recurrent lesion of the right nasal vestibule mucosa
Tumor within the nasal vestibule floor and ala
key_facts: Female patient in her 50s
Never-smoker
Initial lesion biopsied 5 years prior
Initial biopsy reported as solid and cystic hidradenoma
p63 positive, pancytokeratin positive, and p16 negative on initial biopsy
Lesion recurred 8 months prior to presentation
Second excision showed p63 positive and p16 negative with positive margins
Enlarged, firm right ala on examination
Tumor visualized within the nasal vestibule floor and ala
Imaging showed thicker right ala compared to the left ala

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent lesion with local invasion and positive margins

shortlist.label: Hidradenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Initial biopsy reported as solid and cystic hidradenoma with recurrence

shortlist.label: Adnexal carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Lesion location and histological features consistent with adnexal origin

shortlist.label: Basal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Common skin cancer with potential for local invasion

shortlist.label: Sweat gland carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Lesion location and histological features consistent with sweat gland origin

raw.rationale: The patient's lesion recurred multiple times, and the second excision showed positive margins, which suggests an aggressive tumor behavior. The microscopic examination showed downward papillomatous proliferation of small, uniform, slightly atypical keratinocytes, which is consistent with squamous cell carcinoma. Additionally, the p63 positivity is also seen in squamous cell carcinoma.

rejected.label: Hidradenoma Papilliferum
rejected.why: Although the initial biopsy reported a solid and cystic hidradenoma, the recurrence and aggressive behavior of the tumor are not typical of hidradenoma papilliferum

rejected.label: Sweat Gland Adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: There is no specific evidence of sweat gland origin or adenocarcinoma features in the provided pathology reports

rejected.label: Basaloid Squamous Cell Carcinoma
rejected.why: The microscopic examination does not show the characteristic basaloid features of basaloid squamous cell carcinoma

rejected.label: Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma
rejected.why: The tumor is located in the nasal vestibule, not in the oral cavity
